guilds.name: Sunny Mediterranean Trio
guilds.why_it_works: Basil repels flies, Marigold stops root pests, Tomato shades the soil.

guilds.name: Cool Shade Forest Trio

guilds.stencil_guide: Hole A: 1 Mint | Hole B: 3 Parsley | Hole C: 2 Pansies
